categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Private Broadcast' label and directly affects transaction relay origin privacy by routing wallet rebroadcasts through anonymized connections instead of public broadcast.
categories.rationale: Periodic wallet rebroadcasts bypass private broadcast settings and broadcast over regular peer connections, leaking the node's IP address and breaking origin privacy. In P2P, privacy of transaction origin is a primary priority, making an IP leak on rebroadcast when `-privatebroadcast=1` is explicitly configured a category-critical flaw.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet rebroadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: The wallet resubmission logic leaks user IP addresses by using the send-to-all broadcast path instead of respecting `-privatebroadcast=1`. Unresolved rebroadcast IP leakage is a serious privacy defect for wallet users relying on private broadcast.
